M44Ig8m4BfU.title: Fainders.AI VCO On-Site Case Studies｜Toujours Bakery in Cheonan, Niseko Resort in Hokkaido, Japan
M44Ig8m4BfU.description:
Fainders.AI's AI unmanned checkout solution, VCO.
Active across bakeries, resorts, and more, delivering a new retail experience.

⑴99.7% checkout accuracy
Flawless vision AI with zero margin for error: accurately recognizes even complex, overlapping bread and products in one second, cutting off loss at the source.

⑵75% reduction in customer wait time
Ultra-fast checkout that prevents walkaways: no need to find and scan barcodes — just place the whole tray down and checkout is done.

⑶15% increase in sales
Maximizes turnover during peak hours: eliminates checkout bottlenecks during the busiest times, fully capturing additional sales that were previously being missed.

XZ3gEzfrWN0.title: What Makes Fainders.AI VCO Different? ③: Products That Look the Same From Above, VCO Sees Differently!
XZ3gEzfrWN0.description:
What makes Fainders.AI's AI unmanned checkout VCO (Vision Check Out) different, and how?
Can it tell apart products that look identical when viewed from directly above?

[Other Companies]
Only top-view recognition is possible, so if you place items that look identical from above, they can't be told apart properly.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
14 cameras recognize every angle, including side views, without any blind spots — so it tells apart even products that look identical from above.

_0FCk3XMS5w.title: What Makes Fainders.AI VCO Different? ②: Accurately Tells Apart Even Similar-Looking Breads!
_0FCk3XMS5w.description:
What makes Fainders.AI's AI unmanned checkout VCO (Vision Check Out) different, and how?

[Other Companies]
Plain salt bread, basil salt bread, hard salt bread — similar in appearance but different in name and price... Other systems struggle to tell these different products apart, causing errors during checkout.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
99% recognition accuracy for similar-looking products. VCO accurately recognizes breads that look alike but are actually different.

1E0bPZMJZ-o.title: What Makes Fainders.AI VCO Different? ①: Customers Can Resolve Product-Overlap Errors Themselves!
1E0bPZMJZ-o.description:
What makes Fainders.AI's AI unmanned checkout VCO (Vision Check Out) different, and how?

[Other Companies]
If an error occurs from overlapping products, a staff member has to step in and resolve it directly.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
If an error occurs from overlapping products, the customer can simply resolve it themselves just by rearranging the items.
